summary: Navitas Semiconductor Corporation disclosed on Form 8-K that it entered into a Sales Agreement with Craig-Hallum and UBS Securities to conduct an at-the-market offering of up to $125 million of Class A common stock. The filing describes a standard ATM program under Rule 415(a)(4), with compensation of up to 3% of gross proceeds. This is a routine capital markets activity, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or management change. The ATM program allows occasional sales at market prices, and the company has no obligation to sell. The event is a typical shelf takedown mechanism.
